opportunities.name: Research paper lookup and citation note
opportunities.description: For a given research topic, subject category and year, find the newest matching arXiv paper. Then look it up on Semantic Scholar to get its citation count and add a note in the format '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <N> citations'.
steps: Open arXiv Advanced Search (click Search, then Advanced Search, or click New search)
Type the topic keywords in the search term field (field = Title)
Tick the subject checkbox (e.g. Computer Science, Quantitative Biology)
Select 'Specific year' and type the year
Click Search
Copy the title and first author of the first result
Open Semantic Scholar and paste the title into the search box
Click Search and read the citation count of the matching result
Open Notes, click 'New note' and type '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <N> citations', then save

instances.values: topic='retrieval augmented generation', subject=Computer Science, year=2023 → RIGHT: Retrieval-augmented Generation for Mainstream Hashtag Recommendation, Run-Ze Fan, 11 citations
topic='protein structure diffusion', subject=Quantitative Biology, year=2024 → Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models..., Ian Dunn, 7 citations
topic='graph neural networks traffic forecasting', subject=Computer Science, year being entered (not finished)

opportunities.name: Court case citation + related statute note
opportunities.description: Look up a Supreme Court case on CourtListener to get its U.S. Reports citation and decision date. Then look up a related U.S. Code section on Cornell LII to get its heading, and add a note in the format '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<heading>)'.
steps: Open the CourtListener home page
Type the case name in the keyword search box and press Search
Click the Supreme Court result for the case
Read the citation (e.g. 585 U.S. 296) and decision date
Open the Cornell LII home page
Type the statute (e.g. '18 U.S.C. 2703') in the search box and submit
Read the heading of the first result
Open Notes and add '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<heading>)'

instances.values: case='Carpenter v. United States' (585 U.S. 296, June 22, 2018); statute='18 U.S.C. 2703' (Required disclosure of customer communications or records)
case='Bostock v. Clayton County' (590 U.S. 644, June 15, 2020); statute='42 U.S.C. 2000e-2' (Unlawful employment practices)
case='Miranda v. Arizona' (384 U.S. 436, June 13, 1966); stopped before the statute and note steps

opportunities.name: Event venue search on Peerspace (with catering/flowers follow-up)
opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for a venue by activity type and city and look through the listings. For some events, the person then searched ezCater catering for the same city and date and 1-800-Flowers for a flower arrangement.
steps: Open the Peerspace home page or results page
Type the activity in 'What are you planning?' and pick the matching suggestion
Type the city in 'Where?' and pick the matching location suggestion
Click Search and open a promising listing (decline cookie tracking if asked)
Optional: on ezCater, enter the city, pick the delivery date and click Update results
Optional: on 1-800-Flowers, search for the flower item and open the top result
